$comment: The source of sf-progress-ring's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js), written in the standard 1.4 form of five authored files; standard simai.smart-component 1.3.11, vocabulary 1.1.5. Owner request 2026-10-28 (UI Chat thread): «if a component is missing, create it -- e.g. a circular variant of progress, with and without data».

size.summary: The control ladder: at each step the ring is the box of an sf-icon-button or an sf-avatar of the same size.

status.summary: What the value reports, in the shared status vocabulary; the page decides it (a threshold is the page's), the ring never infers it from the value.

indeterminate.summary: The value is unknown: the spinner's arc goes round the ring and no value is said.

meter.summary: The ring shows an amount within a known range (a quota used), not a task's progress: role meter instead of progressbar.

show-text.summary: Shows the percentage in the middle; the slot content takes its place when given.

label.summary: The accessible name; without it the host's aria-label names the ring.

value-text.summary: The value as people say it («3 из 5 файлов»), read instead of the percentage.

chunk.x-summary: Shows a part of a job (vocabulary §5.2 chunk {done, total}): value becomes done of total in per cent; total defaults to 100

content.$comment: What stands in the middle: a picture such as an sf-avatar, fitted to the content box (the ring less its line and gap).

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

accessibility.$comment: The ring itself (.sf-progress-ring-indicator) carries role progressbar, or meter when meter is on, with aria-valuemin 0, aria-valuemax 100, aria-valuenow the value (none while indeterminate) and aria-valuetext the value-text when given; the slot content stays a sibling of it, so a picture keeps its own name. It takes no focus and no keys.

--sf-progress-ring-size.x-summary: The ring's box; the control height of its size by default.

--sf-progress-ring-line-width.x-summary: The line's width, 2 px by default.

--sf-progress-ring-gap.x-summary: Space between the line and what stands in the middle, 2 px by default.

--sf-progress-ring-fill-color.x-summary: The filled part; a status gives its own colour unless this is set.

--sf-progress-ring-track-color.x-summary: The track under the filled part.

x-summary: A value from 0 to 100, or an unknown one, drawn as a ring on the control ladder, with the percentage or a picture in the middle.
x-decisions: one-name-per-concept: the class is a component of its own, progress-ring, not a variant of progress-bar. A bar and a ring are two shapes with different geometry (a track's length against a box on the control ladder, a middle that holds content); a bar class carrying --ring would make one name mean two shapes. The family is shared (progress), and so are the words: value, status with the same five values and the same role tokens, label, value-text, chunk.

geometry: the box is the control height of the size (--sf-ui-<size>--control-height, the sf-icon-button and sf-avatar box: 36 px at 1 below the wide breakpoint, 40 px above it). The line is --sf-a2 (2 px) at every size and the gap --sf-a2, so the content box is the box less 2 x (line + gap): exactly the control height a step down at sizes 1 and 2 (an sf-avatar one step smaller fills it), and a slotted sf-avatar is fitted to it at every size, so the gap stays 2 px.

line-width: 2 px at every size, not 2.5-3 px at 1. Measured (core 1.3 tokens): in the dark theme primary is 11.1:1 against surface-0 and 5.8:1 against the track, in the light theme 6.5:1 and 4.8:1, every status within 0.1 of it -- above the 3:1 of WCAG 1.4.11 at 2 px. The prototype read faint because its mask put the soft edge outside the line (a 1.5 px line) and its gap colour named --sf-surface, which no theme defines. Here the cut is soft across one pixel centred on the line's inner edge, so the line is 2 px; a heavier line would also break the avatar fit (line + gap = one ladder step).

lengths: the published lengths are read through registered internal lengths (@property --sf-progress-ring--size, --line-width, --gap, syntax <length>), so a page that writes a bare 0 keeps the arithmetic; the public names stay unregistered so their fallbacks work. The value is a registered number (--sf-progress-ring--value), so the fill moves between values (--sf-duration-normal; none under prefers-reduced-motion).
drawing: one element, a conic gradient of fill and track cut to the line by a radial mask -- no SVG, so every length is a CSS length the page can set, and it draws in every engine.

indeterminate: the spinner's arc (30% of the ring, one turn per 2 x --sf-duration-slow, linear), on the ring's own track and in its status colour; still under prefers-reduced-motion, as the spinner is. No aria-valuenow while indeterminate (ARIA: an indeterminate progressbar). It is a setting, not value absent, because a value of 0 is a real value.

a11y-role: progressbar, or meter when meter is on (an amount in a known range, such as a quota: Mirai24's usage). The role sits on the ring (.sf-progress-ring-indicator), not on the root: a progressbar's children are presentational, and a slotted avatar keeps its own name beside it. aria-valuenow is the clamped value, aria-valuetext the value-text; the name is label, else the host's aria-label (§3.1, §4.8). No focus, no keys. The visible percentage is aria-hidden: the value is said once, by the ring.
status: the page's. The ring never infers warning or error from the value: thresholds (80, 100 for a quota) belong to the host, which passes status.

text: show-text prints the clamped value with a per cent sign; its size is a text step that keeps «100%» inside the line (--sf-text-size-1/5, 1/4, 1/3 at 1/2, 1, 2; measured in Inter: 23, 29, 35 px inside 24, 32, 40 px). The slot content takes its place when given.
chunk: the progress family's action (vocabulary §5.2), the same as sf-progress-bar's: done of total in per cent, refused for a total that is not positive.
skeleton: none; the ring has no port and no late data: its snapshot is its first paint (§5.4).

box: no x-published root variable. The ring's box is a token a page already has (--sf-ui-<size>--control-height, or --sf-progress-ring-size where the page sets one), and the printed first paint carries the class sheet's box, so nothing is published on :root for a page to reserve it (§5.4).

forbidden_client_responsibilities: running, cancelling or retrying the task
inferring success, warning or error from the numeric percentage

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-progress-ring for a value from 0 to 100 in the room of a control (a toolbar, a rail, around an avatar), or for an unknown one with indeterminate.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
Do not omit a localized accessible label
Do not infer semantic status from the percentage
Do not make the progress indicator focusable
Do not use the ring for a long task in a page's body; use sf-progress-bar

accessibility.focus: Progress Ring is not interactive and never enters the focus order.
